name: Install Dependabot
description: Enable automatic dependency updates with GitHub Dependabot.

variables.pr_body:
## Dependabot Setup

This PR enables [Dependabot](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot) for automatic dependency updates.

### What's included

- **`.github/dependabot.yml`** — Configuration for weekly npm and GitHub Actions dependency updates

### Next steps

1. **Merge this PR**
2. Dependabot will start opening PRs for outdated dependencies
3. Customise the schedule or add more ecosystems in `.github/dependabot.yml`

---

*Installed with [Kerex](https://kerex.app)*

params.content:
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: npm
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    open-pull-requests-limit: 5

outputs.value: A pull request has been created with Dependabot configuration.
